Package theknife.obj.restaurant

Class Restaurant

java.lang.Object
theknife.obj.restaurant.Coordinate
theknife.obj.restaurant.Location
theknife.obj.restaurant.Restaurant
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class Restaurant extends Location
A class that represents a restaurant, extending Location.

This class includes details about a restaurant such as its name, price, phone number, URL, awards, green star, services available, description, and associated reviews.

Author:
Damiano De Mutiis 761348 (CO), Matteo Porto Bonacci 761396 (CO), Matteo Monticone 761701 (CO), Mattia Tamburo 760743 (CO)
